name: Negative - Tool Failure Handling
goal: Bot gracefully handles tool failure and offers retry/help options.
constraints: Valid flow up to tool call. Tool returns failure. Bot shows fallback message and offers Go Home/Main Menu.

phases.description: Run setup workflow and confirm menuType is 'only years'.
User selects 'Get the letter via email'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot triggers workflow and receives failure.
Bot says fallback message and offers Go Home/Main Menu.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
